name: Oversight Supply
tagline: 192 Webflow and Framer templates and 41 sections, with AI-ready prompts for Claude, Cursor, and v0
description:
Oversight Supply is the template membership of Oversight, a web design studio. It holds 192 Webflow and Framer templates and 41 page sections, with Figma source files for some designs. 18 templates are AI-ready: you copy the whole build as one prompt into Claude Code, Cursor, or v0. 32 sections are free to copy after sign-in.

Oversight sells each template on its own for $29 to $129. The membership gives template credits each month, or Lifetime access to the full catalog. Unlocked designs stay in your library after you cancel. The terms allow use in your own or a client project, but not resale or redistribution.
pricing_detail: Starter costs $15 a month for every Pro section and 1 template credit a month. Monthly costs $39 a month for 3 credits. Lifetime costs $499 once for every template and section, now and in future. Credits reset each month, and unlocked designs stay yours after you cancel. 32 sections are free with an account.
agent_guidance:
Use it when a marketing site needs a finished Webflow or Framer design, or a full build prompt for an AI coding tool. Start with the 32 free sections and the free Lumenis prompt to judge the output.

For an AI-ready template, unlock it, copy the full prompt, and give it to the coding agent as the brief. Compare the result with the live preview, and replace the demo copy and images. The license covers your own or client projects only, so do not publish the prompts or files.
why_it_matters: It gives one catalog of studio-made Webflow and Framer templates, and 18 of them come as full build prompts for AI coding tools.
tier_reason: A large catalog of studio-made templates with clear use terms and AI-ready prompts for 18 templates. Most content needs a paid plan, and only 12 templates are for Framer.
notable_for: 18 AI-ready templates with full build prompts
evidence: Checked https://supply.madebyoversight.com/, /pricing, and /terms in curl and Chromium on 2026-10-12. The pricing page lists 192 templates, with 189 for Webflow and 12 for Framer, and 41 sections. The home page lists 18 AI-ready templates and 32 free sections. The pricing page lists Starter at $15 a month, Monthly at $39 a month, and Lifetime at $499 once. The terms allow use in own or client projects and forbid resale. OversightStudio, LLC runs the site.
